questions: Are x and y required to be distinct positive integers, or can they be equal (i.e., x = y)?

Can x and y be larger than 10^6 or any specific bound, or should they be within the range of typical integer types?
If multiple solutions exist, is there any preference for which one to print (e.g., smallest x, smallest y, lexicographically smallest)?
